q: Why did my sales drop yesterday?

checks.what: tool: measures the change with compare_period

answer:
Sales did not drop yesterday — net sales on 2026-10-13 were ₹91,220 versus ₹40,119 on 2026-10-12 (+127.0%), so revenue rose sharply day‑over‑day.

What changed (order‑date basis)
- Net sales: ₹40,119 → ₹91,220 (+127.0%). This is the headline movement.  
- Orders: 26 → 45 (+73.1%) and Net AOV: ₹1,543 → ₹2,027 (+31.3%) — both higher, so more orders and a higher value per order together explain the sales increase.  
- Ad spend and traffic rose: Ad spend ₹38,661 → ₹50,442 (+30.5%); Sessions 3,254 → 3,434 (+5.6%). These moved together with sales but the diagnosis found only same‑day associations, not a tested causal link.  
- Returns / cancel revenue fell: ₹4,913 → ₹1,601 (lower), which also raised net sales versus the prior day.

What the analysis says about cause
- The automated diagnosis found no single supported cause — ad spend, sessions and orders moved together and none met the threshold to be labelled a supported_cause; they are likely correlated. Confidence is that the day’s change is within expected variation for this metric on normal days.  
Worth checking: campaign- and ad-level breakdown for 2026-10-13 (the diagnosis flagged specific ads/campaigns with large changes) to see which drove the orders and higher AOV.
